ceu: ✦ The square between the Sun and Pluto

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Listen to the end before you answer.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between relationships and your career. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Lay out tomorrow's clothes and bag tonight.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between routine and your horizons. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Plan a romantic moment, even a simple one.

t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between romance and intimacy. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Make your bedroom a place of rest: less clutter, more peace.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between family and relationships. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Write an idea down on paper before it slips away.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between conversations and routine. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between money and romance. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Look at yourself in the mirror with the tenderness you show the people you love.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your image and family. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Sleep a little longer, if you can.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between friendships and money. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your career and your image. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.
